q.id: Urutan yang benar: manusia berbuat salah, lalu muncul di kode, lalu terlihat saat dijalankan.
q.en: The correct sequence: a human makes a mistake, it appears in the code, then shows up when executed.

exp.id: Error (kesalahan manusia) menghasilkan defect (bug) di kode; defect yang dieksekusi dapat menyebabkan failure.
exp.en: An error (human mistake) produces a defect (bug) in code; an executed defect may cause a failure.

q.id: Prinsip testing yang menyatakan test yang sama berulang lama-lama tidak menemukan bug baru:
q.en: The testing principle stating that repeating the same tests eventually stops finding new bugs:

exp.id: Solusinya: tinjau dan perbarui test case, tambahkan data dan skenario baru.
exp.en: Fix: review and update test cases, add new data and scenarios.

q.id: Defect clustering berarti...
q.en: Defect clustering means...

id: Bug tersebar merata di semua modul sehingga alokasi testing sebaiknya dibagi rata pula
Sebagian kecil modul memuat sebagian besar defect
Defect hanya ada di lapisan UI karena logika bisnis di backend selalu terjaga
Defect hanya muncul saat produksi karena test environment tidak pernah sama dengan produksi
en: Bugs are spread evenly across all modules so testing effort should be split evenly too
A small number of modules contain most of the defects
Defects exist only in the UI layer because the backend business logic is always safe
Defects only appear in production because test environments are never the same as production

exp.id: Mirip prinsip Pareto (80/20). Fokuskan testing pada modul berisiko tinggi.
exp.en: Similar to the Pareto principle (80/20). Focus testing on high-risk modules.

q.id: "Are we building the right product?" adalah pertanyaan untuk...
q.en: "Are we building the right product?" is the question for...

exp.id: Validation: sesuai kebutuhan user. Verification: "building the product right", sesuai spesifikasi.
exp.en: Validation: meets user needs. Verification: "building the product right", meets the specification.

q.id: Apa beda confirmation testing (re-test) dan regression testing?
q.en: What is the difference between confirmation testing (re-test) and regression testing?

model.id: Confirmation memastikan defect yang diperbaiki benar-benar sudah beres. Regression memastikan perubahan tidak merusak fungsi lain yang sebelumnya berjalan.
model.en: Confirmation verifies a fixed defect is truly resolved. Regression verifies that changes did not break previously working functionality.

q.id: Input umur valid 18-60. Nilai uji BVA (2-value) yang tepat adalah...
q.en: Valid age input is 18-60. The correct BVA (2-value) test values are...

exp.id: Uji batas bawah dan atas beserta tetangga di luar rentang: 17/18 dan 60/61.
exp.en: Test lower and upper boundaries plus their out-of-range neighbours: 17/18 and 60/61.

q.id: Input valid 1-100. Berapa partisi ekuivalen (valid + invalid)?
q.en: Valid input is 1-100. How many equivalence partitions (valid + invalid)?

exp.id: Kurang dari 1 (invalid), 1-100 (valid), lebih dari 100 (invalid) = 3 partisi.
exp.en: Less than 1 (invalid), 1-100 (valid), more than 100 (invalid) = 3 partitions.

q.id: Teknik yang cocok untuk logika dengan kombinasi beberapa kondisi:
q.en: The technique suited for logic with combinations of several conditions:

exp.id: Decision table memetakan kombinasi kondisi ke aksi yang diharapkan.
exp.en: A decision table maps combinations of conditions to expected actions.

q.id: Skenario kartu ATM terblokir setelah 3 kali PIN salah paling cocok diuji dengan...
q.en: A card-blocked-after-3-wrong-PINs scenario is best tested with...

exp.id: Sistem berpindah state berdasarkan event (PIN salah) sehingga state transition cocok.
exp.en: The system changes state based on events (wrong PIN), so state transition fits.

q.id: Typo pada logo di halaman utama perusahaan: kombinasi severity-priority yang tepat?
q.en: A typo in the company logo on the homepage: the right severity-priority combination?

exp.id: Dampak teknis kecil tetapi merusak citra, perlu diperbaiki cepat. Severity = dampak, priority = urgensi.
exp.en: Small technical impact but brand-damaging, needs a quick fix. Severity = impact, priority = urgency.

q.id: Smoke testing adalah...
q.en: Smoke testing is...

id: Pengecekan awal luas dan dangkal untuk memastikan build layak diuji lebih lanjut
Testing mendalam pada satu fitur sampai semua kombinasi inputnya terpenuhi
Performance testing dengan banyak user bersamaan pada production environment
Security testing menyeluruh untuk mencari celah sebelum release ke customer
en: A broad, shallow initial check that a build is stable enough for further testing
Deep testing of one feature until all its input combinations are covered
Performance testing with many concurrent users on the production environment
Thorough security testing to find vulnerabilities before release to customers

exp.id: Sanity testing sempit dan dalam, dilakukan setelah perubahan kecil/bugfix.
exp.en: Sanity testing is narrow and deep, done after small changes/bugfixes.

q.id: Urutan test level dari terkecil ke terbesar:
q.en: Test levels from smallest to largest:

exp.id: Component (unit) → Integration → System → Acceptance (UAT).
exp.en: Component (unit) → Integration → System → Acceptance (UAT).

q.id: Mana yang termasuk static testing?
q.en: Which is static testing?

exp.id: Static testing tidak menjalankan kode: review, walkthrough, inspection, static analysis.
exp.en: Static testing does not execute code: review, walkthrough, inspection, static analysis.

q.id: Statement coverage mengukur...
q.en: Statement coverage measures...

id: Persentase statement kode yang dieksekusi oleh test
en: The percentage of code statements executed by tests

exp.id: Statement coverage termasuk teknik white-box.
exp.en: Statement coverage is a white-box technique.

q.id: Branch (decision) coverage 100% menjamin statement coverage 100%.
q.en: 100% branch (decision) coverage guarantees 100% statement coverage.

exp.id: Branch coverage lebih kuat; ia mencakup statement coverage. Kebalikannya tidak berlaku.
exp.en: Branch coverage is stronger and subsumes statement coverage. The reverse does not hold.

q.id: Apa itu test oracle?
q.en: What is a test oracle?

model.id: Sumber atau mekanisme untuk menentukan hasil yang diharapkan sebuah test, sehingga hasil aktual bisa dibandingkan.
model.en: A source or mechanism used to determine the expected result of a test so actual results can be compared.

q.id: Exploratory testing termasuk kategori...
q.en: Exploratory testing belongs to the category of...

exp.id: Desain dan eksekusi test berjalan bersamaan, memakai pengalaman tester.
exp.en: Test design and execution happen together, using tester experience.

q.id: Teknik black-box didasarkan pada...
q.en: Black-box techniques are based on...

id: Struktur kode internal dan arsitektur yang dibangun oleh tim pengembang
Spesifikasi dan perilaku yang terlihat dari luar
Hanya pengalaman dan intuisi tester tanpa memakai dokumen apa pun sebagai acuan
Hasil review kode yang dilakukan sesama developer sebelum perubahan digabungkan
en: Internal code structure and architecture built by the development team
Only the tester's experience and intuition, without using any document as a reference
Results of code reviews carried out by fellow developers before changes are merged

exp.id: Contoh: EP, BVA, decision table, state transition, use case testing.
exp.en: Examples: EP, BVA, decision table, state transition, use case testing.

q.id: Prinsip early testing menyatakan...
q.en: The early testing principle states...

id: Testing dimulai setelah seluruh coding selesai agar tidak mengganggu pekerjaan developer
Testing dimulai sedini mungkin karena defect lebih murah diperbaiki di awal
Testing hanya dilakukan di akhir sprint ketika seluruh fitur sudah terintegrasi
Testing tidak memerlukan requirement karena tester cukup mengandalkan intuisi
en: Testing starts after all coding is finished so it does not disturb developers' work
Testing starts as early as possible because defects are cheaper to fix early
Testing happens only at the end of the sprint once every feature is integrated
Testing needs no requirements since testers can simply rely on intuition

exp.id: Dikenal juga sebagai shift-left.
exp.en: Also known as shift-left.

q.id: Absence-of-errors fallacy artinya...
q.en: The absence-of-errors fallacy means...

id: Sistem tanpa defect pasti sukses di pasar karena kualitas teknisnya sempurna
Sistem tanpa defect tetap bisa gagal bila tidak memenuhi kebutuhan user
Tidak ada satu pun sistem tanpa defect, jadi testing tidak pernah bisa dianggap selesai
Semua bug pasti ditemukan bila tim melakukan testing cukup lama dengan teknik yang tepat
en: A defect-free system is certain to succeed in the market because its technical quality is perfect
A defect-free system can still fail if it does not meet user needs
No system is ever defect-free, so testing can never be considered finished
All bugs will certainly be found if the team tests long enough with the right techniques

exp.id: Bebas bug bukan berarti berguna bagi user.
exp.en: Being bug-free does not mean useful to users.

q.id: Test plan umumnya memuat...
q.en: A test plan typically contains...

id: Hanya daftar bug yang ditemukan beserta tingkat keparahan masing-masing defect
Hanya kode test otomasi yang akan dijalankan pada pipeline untuk iterasi berjalan
Hanya hasil eksekusi test dari iterasi sebelumnya beserta tanggal dan nama tester
en: Only the list of bugs found along with the severity of each defect
Only the automated test code to be run in the pipeline for the current iteration
Only the test execution results from the previous iteration with date and tester name

exp.id: Plus kriteria masuk/keluar dan risiko.
exp.en: Plus entry/exit criteria and risks.

q.id: Jenis review yang paling formal adalah...
q.en: The most formal type of review is...

exp.id: Inspection punya peran, proses, dan metrik yang terdefinisi.
exp.en: Inspection has defined roles, process, and metrics.

q.id: Testing ulang bug yang sudah diperbaiki disebut...
q.en: Re-testing a fixed bug is called...

exp.id: Confirmation = re-test; regression = cek efek samping ke fitur lain.
exp.en: Confirmation = re-test; regression = check side effects elsewhere.

q.id: Risk-based testing memprioritaskan test berdasarkan...
q.en: Risk-based testing prioritises tests based on...

exp.id: Risiko = kemungkinan terjadi dikali dampaknya.
exp.en: Risk = likelihood of occurring times its impact.

q.id: Contoh non-functional testing:
q.en: An example of non-functional testing:

exp.id: Non-functional: performance, usability, security, reliabilitas, compatibility.
exp.en: Non-functional: performance, usability, security, reliability, compatibility.

q.id: Jelaskan pesticide paradox dan cara mengatasinya.
q.en: Explain the pesticide paradox and how to mitigate it.

model.id: Test yang sama dijalankan berulang akan berhenti menemukan defect baru. Atasi dengan meninjau dan memperbarui test dan data secara berkala.
model.en: Running the same tests repeatedly stops finding new defects. Mitigate by regularly reviewing and updating tests and data.

q.id: Exhaustive testing (menguji semua kombinasi) mungkin dilakukan pada hampir semua sistem.
q.en: Exhaustive testing (testing all combinations) is feasible for almost all systems.

exp.id: Tidak praktis; gunakan risk analysis dan teknik desain test untuk memilih test.
exp.en: Impractical; use risk analysis and test design techniques to choose tests.

q.id: Setelah perbaikan bug diverifikasi lolos, status defect menjadi...
q.en: After a fix is verified, the defect status becomes...

exp.id: Jika masih gagal: Reopened.
exp.en: If it still fails: Reopened.

q.id: Traceability matrix berguna untuk...
q.en: A traceability matrix is used to...

id: Melacak hubungan requirement dengan test case dan defect
Mengukur kecepatan CPU dan memori server selama tes berjalan di environment staging
Menjadwalkan sprint dan membagi tugas anggota tim berdasarkan kapasitas tiap orang
Menyimpan password dan kredensial uji secara aman di repositori bersama
en: Trace the relationship between requirements, test cases, and defects
Measure server CPU and memory speed while tests run in staging
Schedule sprints and split tasks among team members by each person's capacity
Store test passwords and credentials safely in a shared repository

exp.id: Membantu melihat coverage requirement dan analisis dampak perubahan.
exp.en: Helps see requirement coverage and change impact analysis.

q.id: Beta testing dilakukan oleh...
q.en: Beta testing is performed by...

id: User nyata di environment mereka sendiri
en: Real users in their own environment

exp.id: Alpha: internal di environment pengembang. Beta: user eksternal di environment sendiri.
exp.en: Alpha: internal at the developer's site. Beta: external users in their own environment.

q.id: Contoh exit criteria yang masuk akal:
q.en: A reasonable example of exit criteria:

id: Semua defect critical sudah ditutup dan coverage target tercapai
Developer sudah menyelesaikan seluruh pekerjaan pengembangan dan pulang untuk hari itu
Build baru berhasil dibuat dan siap dipasang pada environment testing berikutnya
Sprint baru dimulai sehingga tim perlu segera menyiapkan test case untuk fitur baru
en: All critical defects are closed and the coverage target is met
The developer has finished all development work and gone home for the day
A new build was created successfully and is ready to install in the next test environment
A new sprint started so the team must quickly prepare test cases for the new features

exp.id: Exit criteria menentukan kapan testing dianggap selesai.
exp.en: Exit criteria define when testing is considered done.

q.id: Apa beda Quality Assurance (QA) dan Quality Control (QC)?
q.en: What is the difference between Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC)?

model.id: QA berorientasi proses dan pencegahan defect. QC berorientasi produk dan mendeteksi defect.
model.en: QA is process-oriented and prevents defects. QC is product-oriented and detects defects.
